feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 1 May 2026 11:18am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 01 May 2026 at 11:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the mid-Atlantic and an area of low pressure to the west of Ireland. Various frontal zones affect the British Isles.


##Wind##

South or southeast 2 to 4, soon veering south or southwest 3 to 5, but variable 3 or less in the east of the area until later.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Occasional showers in the east, then risk of showers elsewhere later. Areas of mist and isolated fog patches developing from the south before tending to clear later.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in mist or showers. Very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5 in the west of the area but variable 3 or less in the east. Becoming variable (mainly north) 2 to 4 in all waters overnight into Sunday.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Occasional showers soon becoming isolated. Area of rain approaching from the south later. Areas of mist and isolated fog patches, mainly to start.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in mist, showers or rain. Very poor in fog patches.
